Sitetracker maintains a list of its authorized subprocessors at https://www.sitetracker.com/subprocessors/ and they can be viewed on our Trust Center.

Sitetracker encrypts all sensitive data in transit using AES-128bit at minimum with common secure ciphers and encrypts data at rest using AES-128bit. The option to increase in transit and at rest encryption to AES-256 bit is available.

Sitetracker is a multi-tenant SaaS provider that gives each customer a unique ID, and role-based access control for data segregation.

Sitetracker uses an MDM solution to enforce antivirus, local firewall, disk encryption, auto-updates, and screen timeout, and to remotely lock and wipe devices that are lost or stolen.

Sitetracker is a SaaS-based company and our cloud service provider, Salesforce, is responsible for implementing and maintaining controls related to physical data center security. Please rely on reports, certifications, and attestations from Salesforce when assessing physical security controls.
